hints.title: Segment Boundary Leading Edge
hints.text: A segment begins at any non-space character that is preceded by a space character or is located at index zero.

hints.title: Transition Detection Invariant
hints.text: Checking whether character i is non-whitespace while character i minus one was whitespace identifies the beginning of each distinct segment.

hints.title: Single Pass Transition Counter Procedure
hints.text: Initialize count to zero. Loop through all indices in the string. If the current character is not a space and it is either at index zero or the previous character is a space, increment count. Return count.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Splitting on spaces creates intermediate array tokens and requires filtering out empty strings, consuming extra heap memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single traversal detecting leading word edges runs in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid library split functions and correctly handle leading, trailing, and consecutive spaces.
